candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users experience core value before authenticating.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users upfront; deferring account creation until after pet customization builds emotional investment.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in reduces early friction, targeting a 27.1% drop-off step.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Choice Cards Grid
candidates.change: Redesign the pet picker into a structured grid layout with clear choice cards and action triggers.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean time (1017s); a clear grid design reduces choice paralysis.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pre-made friend or generate a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet picker layout while preserving pet selection functionality is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step loses 39.1% of users; grid redesign reduces choice paralysis.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Control Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated screen explaining desktop controls, key shortcuts, and hiding/showing the pet prior to final intro.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Drag your pet across the screen, right-click for quick actions, or press Ctrl+Pet to start a chat.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls guide screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops 35.2% and support emails confirm confusion with controls.

candidates.title: Animated Companion Arrival Flow
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout with animated setup indicators and desktop readiness notifications.
candidates.why: Home phase mean time is 2336s and 3 support tickets report pets failing to appear on desktop during launch.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival
waiting.body: Configuring desktop overlay and syncing companion assets...

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen while retaining its job of showing the pet being prepared is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: High mean wait time on home step backed by 3 desktop launch support tickets.

candidates.title: Split Screen Story Welcome
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story onboarding screen into a modern split layout with mascot visuals and quick completion timing.
candidates.why: Choose path step has a high mean duration (514s); a clearer welcoming layout sets quick expectations.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Adventure
story.body: Bring an interactive companion directly onto your desktop screen in just 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen while continuing to introduce the pet is allowed under Rules 2 and 4.

candidates.score_note: Initial step drops 23.8% with long duration, but no support mail correlation.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning Hint
candidates.change: Add clear hint text on the sign-in screen reminding users to use the same account to prevent missing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets (largest theme) cited lost or reset pets after signing back in under a different account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.hint: Sign in with the same account every time so your pet's custom memory and data are preserved.

guard.reason: Adding account persistence hints on the sign-in screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Largest support theme (8 tickets) and low-cost hint text change.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Tip Carousel & Guidance
candidates.change: Provide photo upload quality guidance with dynamic tips while generating custom pets.
candidates.why: 3 support messages complained about custom pet generation failures or distorted results.

upload_photos.hint: For best pet generation, upload clear, well-lit photos with a visible subject.

components.text: Tip: Bright lighting produces the best custom desktop pets!

guard.reason: Adding photo upload guidance during pet creation is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop-off step (39.1%) and 3 support tickets regarding generation failures.

candidates.title: Desktop Readiness Confirmation Copy
candidates.change: Update final screen headline and messaging to explicitly confirm the pet is running on the user's desktop.
candidates.why: Finish stage mean time is 5815s with drop-offs occurring near completion due to confusion on desktop state.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at your desktop! Your pet is now roaming around. Click on them anytime to feed, play, or chat.

guard.reason: Updating text on the home intro screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has huge mean duration and 35.2% drop, fast copy tweak.

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Incentive Badge
candidates.change: Add a welcome bonus badge on the choose_path screen offering a free starter accessory.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of top-of-funnel users; offering an immediate item incentive boosts motivation.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Journey & Unlock Starter Items
choose_path.body: Choose how you want to create your pet today and receive a free starter hat!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'free starter hat' and 'Free Starter Accessory', violating Rule 3's ban on mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Centered Adoption Certificate Layout
candidates.change: Switch adoption certificate view to a centered layout emphasizing pet naming and certificate completion.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the biggest drop (39.1% lost); a celebratory certificate layout increases emotional attachment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Name your pet and claim your official certificate of adoption!

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

lessons_next: The evidence is still thin to establish rules, as only one test has been completed so far.
